intro: The website is JavaScript: the Express server and the tools that build and check it. The Design Studio (swatchroom/) is a Node app too, but its models are not: the scan models run on PyTorch and the GPU services are defined in Python, and both are reached over HTTP. What lives where, and why:

rows.why: The whole site is a handful of files and a route table.
They must run first, on every request, in the one process that faces the browser.
One place decides where the server listens and which Host names it answers to. The real environment wins over the file, and the file is re-read when it changes.

rows.piece: Site build, link check, this overview
rows.why: Text processing on files, in the same runtime as the server, so a clone needs Node and nothing else to build and check the site.

The studio is a Node app (Express and MongoDB), so the website loads it into its own process. That is what lets the landing page start the cold start and the studio's start-up check read the answer: one process, one record of which GPU services are awake.
SegFormer and SlimSAM run on PyTorch. The studio sends photos to this small service over HTTP and falls back to Gemini outlines when it is not running.
OneFormer, MoGe-2, Marigold and SAM 3 run on Modal GPUs that scale to zero; one Python file defines every pool, its GPUs and its idle time.
